_doc: Daily rhythms (T-0036). sleep_hours: [start, end] in whole hours, wrapping past midnight when end < start. Inside the window sleep is attractive and sleepers stay in bed until it ends. out_hours: the evening window for going out (T-0052). weight: how often generated residents get the routine (0: only given to people whose job needs it, T-0060). default: the player's routine (and anyone without one).
